content.user_title: Audit Your Paid Ad Account Readiness
content.value_statement: Paid-media reports can overstate returns when attribution, outcome data, or safety evidence is incomplete. This skill applies a structured ROAS audit to identify evidence gaps, verified controls, and next actions before scaling spend.
actual_capabilities: Collects required context for currency, attribution windows, conversion lag, goals, and business constraints.
Evaluates 20 ROAS criteria across audience, offer, return, and spend efficiency.
Separates own-data outcome evidence from platform-reported attribution.
Marks missing evidence as Unknown instead of treating it as a passing result.
Flags verified measurement, claims, policy, and placement-safety veto conditions.
Produces a SHIP, FIX, BLOCK, or UNDECIDED readiness result without changing ad-account settings.
limitations: It relies on the accuracy and completeness of exported account, outcome, and placement data.
It does not enable campaigns, modify bids, upload audiences, or change budgets.
It cannot prove incrementality without a holdout, geo split, or other causal evidence.
A standalone installation can collect observations but cannot calculate the final typed score.

use_cases.title: Pre-scale account review
use_cases.description: Review an established account before increasing budget or changing a bidding strategy.

use_cases.title: Measurement integrity check
use_cases.description: Compare platform attribution with deduplicated ecommerce, analytics, or CRM outcomes.

use_cases.title: Agency handoff assessment
use_cases.description: Create an evidence-based readiness report for a client or internal stakeholder.

prompt_templates.title: Start a basic audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this paid ad account for direct response. Use USD, a 7-day click window, a 3-day conversion lag, and a CAC ceiling of $120. Tell me which exports you need.

prompt_templates.title: Review exported outcomes
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit these campaign and order-ID exports. Separate platform-reported conversions from deduplicated own-data outcomes and mark any missing evidence as Unknown.

prompt_templates.title: Check scaling readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether this portfolio is ready to scale. Use the incremental-profit profile, the attached holdout results, margin constraint, placement report, and attribution windows.

prompt_templates.title: Request a traceable report
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a traceable ROAS audit with profile context, all 20 criterion states, evidence provenance, verified vetoes, unknown inputs, owners, fixes, and rerun conditions.

output_examples.input: Audit a direct-response account with complete spend and order exports but no placement report.
output: Measurement evidence is sufficient for initial review.
Placement safety remains Unknown because no placement report was provided.
Next action: provide the placement report before a readiness verdict.

output_examples.input: Review an account where platform conversions exceed deduplicated order IDs.
output: Evidence: platform totals do not reconcile with the declared own-data truth set.
Next action: correct deduplication and rerun the audit.

best_practices: Provide normalized exports with source, date, attribution window, currency, and conversion-lag details.
Use deduplicated own-data outcomes as the primary truth set for performance assessment.
Treat Unknown results as evidence gaps that require follow-up, not as passing controls.
anti_patterns: Do not use platform-reported ROAS as the only measure of incremental value.
Do not compare accounts with different currencies, windows, or conversion lags without normalization.
Do not scale spend when required evidence or verified safety controls are missing.

faq.question: Does this skill change my advertising account?
faq.answer: No. It evaluates exported evidence and does not make account or budget changes.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide delivery, spend, outcome, attribution, economics, and placement evidence when available.

faq.question: Can it calculate ROAS from platform data alone?
faq.answer: It can review the data, but it treats platform reporting as an input rather than the sole truth set.

faq.question: What happens when evidence is missing?
faq.answer: The relevant criterion is marked Unknown, which can result in an UNDECIDED outcome.

faq.question: Can it evaluate incrementality?
faq.answer: Yes, when holdout, geo split, or comparable causal-test evidence is provided. Otherwise it labels the result as a proxy.

faq.question: When can it save an audit artifact?
faq.answer: Only after explicit authorization and validation of the complete audit draft.
